evidence.title: US Diesel Sales Price
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was -1.017 percent; it resolved to 'yes'.

evidence.title: December fuel prices mostly fall: Diesel down, gas nears $3/gal nationally | FleetOwner
evidence.summary: This source directly states the U.S. on-highway diesel price average for the week of December 4th, noting it's up less than a cent to $3.540 per gallon, and 55 cents cheaper than the previous year. It also provides regional breakdowns for early December.

evidence.title: This Week In Petroleum Summary Printer-Friendly Version - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
evidence.summary: This EIA report provides the U.S. retail diesel price for November 25, 2024, at $3.539 per gallon, and indicates a weekly increase of $0.048. This serves as a crucial data point for calculating the monthly change into December.

evidence.title: National weekly diesel average grows, after largest decline of 2024 - Supply Chain 24/7
evidence.summary: This article details the weekly diesel price movements in December, noting a rise to $3.494 for the week of December 16th, following an 8.2-cent decline the previous week. It also mentions a 4.8-cent increase for the week of November 25th to $3.539.

evidence.title: Benchmark diesel price hits a low it hasn’t seen in more than 3 years - FreightWaves
evidence.summary: This source reports a significant decline of 8.2 cents a gallon for the week of December 9th, bringing the price to $3.458 a gallon, which was the largest drop in almost a year and the lowest price since October 2021. This directly contributes to the monthly change.

evidence.title: Diesel benchmark up slightly; futures market soars on forecast of extreme cold - FreightWaves
evidence.summary: This article provides the final DOE/EIA average retail diesel price for the year at $3.503 a gallon, an increase of 2.7 cents. This is a key data point for the end of December.

evidence.title: EIA expects average U.S. gasoline and diesel prices to decrease in 2024 and 2025 - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
evidence.summary: This EIA outlook from January 2024 predicted decreasing diesel prices throughout 2024 due to increased refinery capacity and lower crack spreads, providing a long-term context for the observed price declines in December.

evidence.title: January "Fueling Intelligence: 2024 in Review" - Guttman Energy
evidence.summary: This review summarizes that the average price of diesel in the U.S. in December 2024 was $3.49, the lowest in 24 months, primarily due to lower crude oil prices. It also notes stable inventories and weak consumption.

evidence.title: National Average Drops Below $3, First Time in 1,308 Days - GasBuddy
evidence.summary: This source provides the national average price of diesel as $3.491 per gallon for the week of December 2nd, noting a 2.3 cent decline from the previous week. This is a direct data point for early December.
